claim.statement: Parent_6 and parent_8 both correctly identify parity-interleaving for x0 in [8,17] but fail at x0>=18. The training data shows: even x0 in {8,10,12,14,16} -> {12,11,10,9,8} (descending by 1), odd x0 in {9,11,13,15,17} -> {21,22,23,24,25} (ascending by 1). At x0=18,19,20,21 the pattern changes to {43,62,42,63}. This suggests a block structure where each block of ~14 values has different linear/quadratic laws. For x0>=18, even: 43,42 and odd: 62,63, which suggests new interleaved sequences with a quadratic component.
